prompt: Round 4 of 6. The company side proposes (We accept the narrowed exclusivity field to EdgeWatch, which protects our product roadmap. We want an option to assign

content.text: The company wants uni_owns_option_to_assign instead of uni_owns_option_to_licence. I can accept this - it's a reasonable trade given they accepted our narrowed exclusivity field. The option to assign means they could take full ownership later, but university retains ownership during the research period and publication rights are protected. This meets our core needs.
